# Stocks: REST API Reference

25 REST endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Aggregates

### Custom Bars (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{stocksTicker}/range/{multiplier}/{timespan}/{from}/{to}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/aggregates/custom-bars.md)

Retrieve aggregated historical OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified stock ticker over a custom date range and time interval in Eastern Time (ET).

- **Params:** `stocksTicker`\*, `multiplier`\*, `timespan`\*, `from`\*, `to`\*, `adjusted`, `sort`, `limit`
- **Returns:** `ticker adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `c h l n o otc t v vw` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic 2y · Starter 5y · Developer 10y · Advanced all

### Daily Market Summary (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/grouped/locale/us/market/stocks/{date}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/aggregates/daily-market-summary.md)

Retrieve daily OHLC (open, high, low, close), volume, and volume-weighted average price (VWAP) data for all U.S. stocks on a specified trading date.

- **Params:** `date`\*, `adjusted`, `include_otc`
- **Returns:** `adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `T c h l n o otc t v vw`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic 2y · Starter 5y · Developer 10y · Advanced all

### Daily Ticker Summary (OHLC)

`GET /v1/open-close/{stocksTicker}/{date}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/aggregates/daily-ticker-summary.md)

Retrieve the opening and closing prices for a specific stock ticker on a given date, along with any pre-market and after-hours trade prices.

- **Params:** `stocksTicker`\*, `date`\*, `adjusted`
- **Returns:** `afterHours close from high low open otc preMarket symbol volume`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic 2y · Starter 5y · Developer 10y · Advanced all

### Previous Day Bar (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{stocksTicker}/prev` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/aggregates/previous-day-bar.md)

Retrieve the previous trading day's open, high, low, and close (OHLC) data for a specified stock ticker.

- **Params:** `stocksTicker`\*, `adjusted`
- **Returns:** `ticker adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `T c h l n o t v vw`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

## Market Operations

### Condition Codes

`GET /v3/reference/conditions` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/condition-codes.md)

Retrieve a unified and comprehensive list of trade and quote conditions from various upstream market data providers (e.g., CTA, UTP, OPRA, FINRA).

- **Params:** `asset_class`, `data_type`, `id`, `sip`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `abbreviation asset_class data_types description exchange id legacy name sip_mapping type update_rules` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Exchanges

`GET /v3/reference/exchanges` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/exchanges.md)

Retrieve a list of known exchanges, including their identifiers, names, market types, and other relevant attributes.

- **Params:** `asset_class`, `locale`
- **Returns:** results[]: `acronym asset_class id locale mic name operating_mic participant_id type url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Market Holidays

`GET /v1/marketstatus/upcoming` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/market-holidays.md)

Retrieve upcoming market holidays and their corresponding open/close times.

- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Market Status

`GET /v1/marketstatus/now` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/market-status.md)

Retrieve the current trading status for various exchanges and overall financial markets.

- **Returns:** `afterHours currencies earlyHours exchanges indicesGroups market serverTime` · currencies: `crypto fx` · exchanges: `nasdaq nyse otc` · indicesGroups: `cccy cgi dow_jones ftse_russell msci mstar mstarc nasdaq s_and_p societe_generale`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated in real time

## News

### News

`GET /v2/reference/news` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/news.md)

Retrieve the most recent news articles related to a specified ticker, along with summaries, source details, and sentiment analysis.

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `published_utc` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `amp_url article_url author description id image_url insights keywords published_utc publisher tickers title` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated hourly · history Basic 2y · Starter–Advanced all

## Snapshots

### Full Market Snapshot

`GET /v2/snapshot/locale/us/markets/stocks/tickers` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/snapshots/full-market-snapshot.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive snapshot of the entire U.S. stock market, covering over 10,000+ actively traded tickers in a single response.

- **Params:** `tickers`, `include_otc`
- **Returns:** `tickers` · tickers[]: `day fmv lastQuote lastTrade min prevDay ticker todaysChange todaysChangePerc updated`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Single Ticker Snapshot

`GET /v2/snapshot/locale/us/markets/stocks/tickers/{stocksTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/snapshots/single-ticker-snapshot.md)

Retrieve the most recent market data snapshot for a single ticker.

- **Params:** `stocksTicker`\*
- **Returns:** `ticker` · ticker: `day fmv lastQuote lastTrade min prevDay ticker todaysChange todaysChangePerc updated`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Top Market Movers

`GET /v2/snapshot/locale/us/markets/stocks/{direction}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/snapshots/top-market-movers.md)

Retrieve snapshot data highlighting the top 20 gainers or losers in the U.S. stock market.

- **Params:** `direction`\*, `include_otc`
- **Returns:** `tickers` · tickers[]: `day fmv lastQuote lastTrade min prevDay ticker todaysChange todaysChangePerc updated`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Unified Snapshot

`GET /v3/snapshot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/snapshots/unified-snapshot.md)

Retrieve unified snapshots of market data for multiple asset classes including stocks, options, forex, and cryptocurrencies in a single request.

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt .any_of), `type`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `error fmv fmv_last_updated last_minute last_quote last_trade market_status message name session ticker type` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

## Tickers

### All Tickers

`GET /v3/reference/tickers` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/all-tickers.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive list of ticker symbols supported by Massive across various asset classes (e.g., stocks, indices, forex, crypto).

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `type`, `market`, `exchange`, `cusip`, `cik`, `date`, `search`, `active`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `active base_currency_name base_currency_symbol cik composite_figi currency_name currency_symbol delisted_utc last_updated_utc locale market name primary_exchange share_class_figi ticker type` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated daily · history Basic 2y · Starter–Advanced all

### Related Tickers

`GET /v1/related-companies/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/related-tickers.md)

- **Params:** `ticker`\*
- **Returns:** `ticker` · results[]: `ticker`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated daily

`GET /v3/reference/tickers/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-overview.md)

- **Params:** `ticker`\*, `date`
- **Returns:** results: `active address branding cik composite_figi currency_name delisted_utc description homepage_url list_date locale market market_cap name phone_number primary_exchange round_lot share_class_figi share_class_shares_outstanding sic_code sic_description ticker ticker_root ticker_suffix total_employees type weighted_shares_outstanding`

## Trades & Quotes

### Last Quote

`GET /v2/last/nbbo/{stocksTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/trades-quotes/last-quote.md)

Retrieve the most recent National Best Bid and Offer (NBBO) quote for a specified stock ticker, including the latest bid/ask prices, sizes, exchange details, and timestamp.

- **Params:** `stocksTicker`\*
- **Returns:** results: `P S T X c f i p q s t x y z`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced Real-time

### Last Trade

`GET /v2/last/trade/{stocksTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/trades-quotes/last-trade.md)

Retrieve the latest available trade for a specified stock ticker, including details such as price, size, exchange, and timestamp.

- **Params:** `stocksTicker`\*
- **Returns:** results: `T c ds e f i p q r s t x y z`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Quotes

`GET /v3/quotes/{stockTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/trades-quotes/quotes.md)

Retrieve National Best Bid and Offer (NBBO) quotes for a specified stock ticker over a defined time range.

- **Params:** `stockTicker`\*, `timestamp` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `ask_exchange ask_price ask_size bid_exchange bid_price bid_size conditions indicators participant_timestamp sequence_number sip_timestamp tape trf_timestamp` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced Real-time · history Advanced all

### Trades

`GET /v3/trades/{stockTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/trades-quotes/trades.md)

Retrieve comprehensive, tick-level trade data for a specified stock ticker within a defined time range.

- **Params:** `stockTicker`\*, `timestamp` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `conditions correction decimal_size exchange id participant_timestamp price sequence_number sip_timestamp size tape trf_id trf_timestamp` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Developer 10y · Advanced all
